messages:
deploy-bot: Incoming canary for service=llm-router image=redwood/llm-router:v3.0.0 in 3m. Planned flag changes: llmrouter_warmup=10% -> 30% over 45m. Change window 21:30-01:00 UTC. Please review. @emma @raj

emma: saw a small p95 regression in staging replay (about +12%). putting ramp on hold until QA confirms.

raj: noted. Can we set flag to 0% for canary and add a startup prefetch tweak in rollout config? Might be a cold-cache issue.

ops-ash: set llmrouter_warmup=0% in canaries and paused automation. Logged: "hold: investigate staging p95 bump" :pause_button:

qa-lin: running focused cold-start suite against v3.0.0 with trace capture. ETA ~10m. Will report results here.

derek: adding a temporary safety gate: abort if p95 > baseline +7% for 10m during ramp.

qa-lin: results: 4 traces show cold-start token tail; median OK. Attaching brief trace ids.

emma: thanks. plan: patch rollout config to include prefetch=2 and kv-seed=8s, re-run staging. If smoke passes, do a conservative tiny ramp: 1% -> 5% -> 15% over 2h with safety gate. Otherwise rollback to v2.9.5 and pin.

raj: rollback pin snippet:
```
redwoodctl route pin --service llm-router --version v2.9.5 --reason "canary regressions"
redwoodctl deploy abort --id 1769994444
```

ops-ash: added release-note draft: "Canary paused: v3.0.0 ramp delayed for warmup fix; no customer impact." PMs notified. Canary remains queued until manual resume by @emma or @raj. :white_check_mark:
